svg.title: The 15 patterns of Stello 2's evaluation (plus15)
svg.desc: Fifteen small boards, a1 at the top left. Each shows one pattern in its canonical place. Green: the 11 classic patterns: rows 2, 3 and 4, the diagonals of 4 to 8 squares, the edge with both X-squares, the 2 by 5 corner and the 3 by 3 corner. Orange: the four shapes taken from Egaroucid 7.9: triangle, corner plus block, cross, and edge plus y. Under each board: the number of squares, the number of places on the board, and the number of weights per stage after folding. Together the patterns have 62 places (features).
svg.text: Each board shows a pattern in its canonical place (a1 top left). Its other places are the same squares turned by a symmetry of the board.
Weights per stage after folding: 233,676 in all.
